title: Pagination
definition: When your database has millions of records, you cannot return them all in a single API call. Pagination limits the number of results per request. It is typically controlled via `page` and `limit` query parameters.

answers.question: When should you avoid using Pagination?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
